6132.title: Android selection toolbar overlap: native verification unavailable
6132.rootCauseOneLine: Root cause unverified: touch selections use the live range and default to an above-selection popover, but overlap with Android's native menu was not exercised.
6132.proposedFix: First reproduce on a real Android browser with the native menu open, then validate alternate placement near viewport edges and with multi-line selections before selecting a fix.
6132.caveats: Both clean trusted checkouts passed the same 70 existing selection tests. No Android runtime or Chrome was available; browser automation could not open. No screenshot was captured or fetched, no native-overlap regression failed, and no production fix or PR was safe. Verification covers repeated limited findings, not confirmation of the Android defect. Reproduction commands and output are inline; raw artifacts stay outside the public repository.
